public_rationale: On October 23, 2025, Google Cloud announced that Anthropic would gain access to well over one gigawatt coming online during 2026 [e1]. That announcement gives no amount operational during January–March 2026 [e1]. On April 6, 2026, Google Cloud announced multiple additional gigawatts expected to come online starting in 2027 [e2]. This expansion included Google Cloud services and Google-built chips supplied through Broadcom [e2]. Neither announcement gives a measured capacity share for Anthropic during January–March 2026 [e1, e2].
limitations: The packet does not verify or define Google's stated 2.95 GW capacity base.
The announcements do not establish whether Anthropic used or held at least 1.475 GW of operational capacity during January–March 2026.
A comparison requires matching geography, operational dates, accelerator coverage and electrical power measurements.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: He estimates that Anthropic takes up at least half of Google's 2.95GW of capacity.

statement.excerpt: Google now plans to invest up to $43 billion in Anthropic, a company that I estimate takes up at least half of its 2.95GW of capacity, which has cost it around $211 billion in capex since 2023.
statement.document_title: Am I Meant To Be Impressed?

our_interpretation: Assess the normalized capacity proposition. The investment and cumulative capex figures in the surrounding sentence are contextual, not additional claims graded here.
At least half of 2.95 GW means at least 1.475 GW.
Takes up means operational capacity allocated to or used by Anthropic, measured on the same power basis as Google's denominator.
Use January–March 2026, the latest completed reporting quarter before the post, for the ongoing capacity observation.
The phrase author's estimate qualifies confidence; it is not a conditional antecedent.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable records establish a 2.95 GW Google capacity base and at least 1.475 GW allocated to or used by Anthropic during the target period.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable records establish Anthropic's allocation below 1.475 GW on the stated denominator, or otherwise establish that its share of the intended Google capacity base was below half.

evidence.explanation: The announcement describes planned access during 2026, without a first-quarter delivered amount. Well over one gigawatt supplies neither an upper bound below 1.475 GW nor a lower bound above it.
This is a future expansion announcement. It cannot establish Anthropic's existing share of Google's capacity during January–March 2026.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: Records defining Google's capacity base and Anthropic's operational allocation or use during January–March 2026 on the same measurement basis. These must establish whether Anthropic's share reached half of the stated 2.95 GW base.
